Hi Ari —

Great conversation today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary from discovery
- Primary goal: move from manual rules to assisted summarization for support transcripts; target 30% reduction in TTR by Q4.
- Data profile: ~2.5M short transcripts / month, mostly English, PII redaction required.
- Constraints: must run in VPC with KMS-managed keys; on-prem option possible later.

Proposed next step: 30-minute product walk-through (intro + fit discussion) with the stakeholders you mentioned. Please pick one of the windows below (all times PT):
1) Tue 26 May — 9:30–10:00 PT
2) Wed 27 May — 13:00–13:30 PT
3) Thu 28 May — 16:00–16:30 PT

Requested attendees
- Product/PO (priority)
- Engineering / infra lead (for questions about data flow & VPC)
- Security/Compliance (for data residency & KMS)

Pre-demo asks (small list, will help us tailor the session):
- Which SSO provider do you use? (Okta/SAML/other)
- A single redacted sample transcript or schema (if available) — helps us size serving config.
- Any I/O throughput targets or latency SLOs you care about.

I’ve attached the short discovery notes from today and our proposed MVP priorities so your team can review before the call. If none of those windows work, share two alternatives and we’ll loop in calendar ops.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com
